title: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(4)
desc: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(4)

paragraphs.en: Accessibility may, as the disability scholar Tanya Titchkosky has pointed out, exist in much the same way as "diversity" does - for the sake of bragging rights on the part of institutions, organisations and companies.
paragraphs.zh: 正如残疾问题学者坦尼娅·蒂奇科斯基所指出的，无障碍环境的存在方式可能与“多样性”的存在方式极为相似——是为了让机构、组织和公司有吹嘘的资本。

paragraphs.en: If a few minority representatives are made visible, are included, then that serves as sufficient evidence that anti-discrimination policies have been put in place and are good enough.
paragraphs.zh: 如果能让少数群体的代表露个脸、被纳入其中，那就足以证明反歧视政策已经实施且效果良好。

paragraphs.en: However, in her wide-reaching argument about the political limits of non-discrimination, the academic and author Amia Srinivasan invokes intersectional analysis, pointing out that discrimination "on the grounds of sex" is always easiest to identify in cases where sex alone can be used to distinguish between cases, ie in order to establish that "discrimination" has taken place.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在她关于非歧视政治局限性的广泛论述中，学者兼作家阿米娅·斯里尼瓦桑运用了交叉性分析，指出“基于性别的”歧视在仅靠性别就能区分不同情况时最容易被识别，也就是说，要确定“歧视”确实发生了。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, a lack of inclusion may well persist for the vast majority of women.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，绝大多数女性可能仍然无法被纳入其中。

paragraphs.en: The more that other forms of political marginalisation are involved - having to do with poverty, racism or health - then the harder, and less relevant, it becomes to establish discrimination "on the grounds of sex".
paragraphs.zh: 当涉及到更多其他形式的政治边缘化问题，如贫困、种族主义或健康问题时，要确定“基于性别的”歧视就会变得更加困难，也更没有意义。

paragraphs.en: A strategy for inclusion that benefits rich, white, non-disabled cis women is not necessarily a strategy that benefits all women.
paragraphs.zh: 一种让富裕、白人、非残疾的顺性别女性受益的包容策略，不一定能让所有女性受益。

paragraphs.en: It may help a small subset of women gain power within existing structures, but it is highly likely to include those who are already the most privileged members of "their group" - homogeneously conceived, heterogeneous in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 它可能会帮助一小部分女性在现有结构中获得权力，但很有可能会将那些已经是“她们群体”中最有特权的成员纳入其中——从概念上讲是同质的，在实践中却是异质的。

paragraphs.en: This feminist argument, too, is sufficiently flexible that it applies to disability.
paragraphs.zh: 这种女权主义观点也具有足够的灵活性，它同样适用于残疾问题。

paragraphs.en: It certainly applies to me.
paragraphs.zh: 这当然也适用于我。

paragraphs.en: As a highly educated wheelchair user who also belongs to the ethnic-majority population in what is arguably the world's richest welfare state, I have little doubt that I've personally benefited greatly, and more than most disabled people, from the disability field's turn to the political logic of anti-discrimination.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名受过高等教育的轮椅使用者，同时我还属于可以说是世界上最富裕福利国家的多数族裔群体，我毫不怀疑，个人从残疾领域转向反歧视政治逻辑的转变中获益匪浅，而且比大多数残疾人受益更多。

paragraphs.en: I am one of the privileged few; my status as a disabled person can very nearly be thought of as something external to me, situated in my wheelchair.
paragraphs.zh: 我是少数享有特权的人之一；我的残疾人身份几乎可以被视为我之外的东西，体现在我的轮椅上。

paragraphs.en: If not for it (or rather, the reason I need it), I would be "like everyone else".
paragraphs.zh: 如果不是因为它（或者更确切地说，是我需要它的原因），我就会“和其他人一样”。

paragraphs.en: This was the logic that resulted in the UN Convention, and in the various national pieces of legislation.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是促成《联合国公约》以及各国相关立法出台的逻辑。

paragraphs.en: And although the laws have differing degrees of political bite, it cannot be denied that their existence has shifted the public discourse and, to an extent, public opinion.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些法律在政治影响力上有所不同，但不可否认的是，它们的存在改变了公众话语，在一定程度上也改变了公众舆论。

paragraphs.en: Discriminating against disabled people is, to a much greater extent than previously, not cool.
paragraphs.zh: 与以往相比，歧视残疾人在很大程度上已经不再是一件光彩的事了。

paragraphs.en: I know this because the world around me has changed as I have grown older.
paragraphs.zh: 我知道这一点，是因为随着我年龄增长，周围的世界也发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: I remember a time in Norway when practically no one acted apologetically because of a lack of access; the problem was always me, the wheelchair user, and my unreasonable expectation of being let in.
paragraphs.zh: 我记得在挪威曾有一段时间，几乎没有人因为无障碍设施缺失而表现出歉意；问题总是出在我这个轮椅使用者身上，以及我期望被允许进入的不合理要求。

paragraphs.en: This is no longer true.
paragraphs.zh: 如今情况已不再如此。

paragraphs.en: There are even newly built areas of my city, Oslo, where I will show up at a venue without checking accessibility in advance - a risk I would not have taken even a decade ago.
paragraphs.zh: 甚至在我所在的城市奥斯陆，有些新建区域里，我可以不提前确认无障碍设施就前往某个场所——这是哪怕在十年前我都不敢冒的风险。

paragraphs.en: In the newest additions, I am spared the invisible work of mapping out routes, checking images online, making calls, writing emails.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些最新的建筑中，我无需再默默承担规划路线、查看网络图片、打电话、写邮件这些隐形工作。

paragraphs.en: I am allowed, within the confines of this space, to trust the utopian claim that I will be allowed to participate fully and on equal terms with others.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个空间范围内，我被允许相信那个乌托邦式的承诺：我将能够完全平等地与他人共同参与。

paragraphs.en: The space is small, however, and I could claim discrimination many times a day, if I chose to do so. Or could I?
paragraphs.zh: 这个空间很小，然而，如果我选择这样做，我一天中可以多次声称受到歧视。或者我真的可以吗？

paragraphs.en: I return to the gate to the kindergarten, asking whether its existence discriminates against me.
paragraphs.zh: 我回到幼儿园的大门，询问它的存在是否歧视了我。

paragraphs.en: Yes, it is inconvenient for me to open – risky, even, in winter.
paragraphs.zh: 是的，对我来说打开它很不方便——甚至在冬天还有风险。

paragraphs.en: It is not simply a gate, but a barrier - what the UN convention, for example, aims to do away with.
paragraphs.zh: 它不仅仅是一扇门，而是一道屏障——例如，联合国公约旨在消除的正是这类障碍。

paragraphs.en: The UN convention, however, also has other concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，联合国公约还有其他关切。

paragraphs.en: First and foremost, it is concerned with providing "reasonable accommodation" - that is, forms of accommodation that do not impose "undue burdens" on others.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，它关注的是提供"合理便利"——即不会对他人施加"过度负担"的便利形式。

paragraphs.en: The disadvantage imposed on me by a gate I cannot open must be weighed against the risk that an "undue burden" will be imposed on whoever would be responsible for replacing the gate with one that I can open.
paragraphs.zh: 我因无法打开的门而承受的不利处境，必须与可能对负责更换门的人施加“过度负担”的风险进行权衡。

paragraphs.en: And so the question is never simply "Am I being discriminated against?"
paragraphs.zh: 因此，问题从来不仅仅是“我是否受到歧视？”

paragraphs.en: In practice, it is also "How much of my invisible work can reasonably be shifted on to society?"
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，它也是“我的隐形劳动有多少可以合理地转移给社会？”

paragraphs.en: This question inevitably brings us back to Daniels' analysis of the moral frame that makes invisible work seem inevitable and natural.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题不可避免地让我们回到丹尼尔斯对道德框架的分析，该框架使得隐形劳动显得不可避免且自然而然。

paragraphs.en: What constitutes a reasonable request is a moral issue.
paragraphs.zh: 什么才是合理的要求，这是一个道德问题。

paragraphs.en: And so, for each of the hundreds of troublesome tasks that I encounter throughout the day, if I ask whether I'm being discriminated against, I must also ask whether I am being unreasonable.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，对于我一天中遇到的数百项麻烦任务中的每一项，如果我问自己是否受到了歧视，那么我也必须问自己是否不讲道理。

paragraphs.en: Whether I am, unreasonably, trying to evade the duties that follow naturally, inevitably, from having a body that cannot do the things that bodies should naturally be able to do.
paragraphs.zh: 我是否不合理地试图逃避那些自然而必然地、因拥有一个无法完成身体本应能完成之事的身体而产生的责任。

paragraphs.en: But I don't have the stamina to make these judgments for myself and for society.
paragraphs.zh: 但我没有精力为自己和社会做出这些判断。

paragraphs.en: I don't have the fortitude to ask what is reasonable or unreasonable, never mind to ask which entity is responsible and how to seek recourse.
paragraphs.zh: 我没有勇气去问什么是合理或不合理的，更不用说去问哪个实体该为此负责以及如何寻求赔偿了。

paragraphs.en: There is, quite simply, too much I have to do.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之，我有太多事情要做。
